Hi Olivia — thanks for sending this over. Quick sync on our side and a request list so we can move to a conditional PO: 

1) W-9 name alignment: please send a corrected W-9 that uses the IRS legal name "Orchid Cloud Solutions, LLC" OR confirm in writing that Orchid prefers to be paid under the DBA and provide legal paperwork (doing the former is usually faster).

2) Signatory authorization: our AP policy requires either a board resolution OR a signatory declaration signed by the person on the W-9. We have a short template — I'll share a DocuSign link if you confirm you'd like to sign electronically.

3) Bank/ACH info: we accept a bank letter or an ACH voided check. Please do NOT send bank account numbers over plain email; you can upload to our secure vendor portal (link below) or use DocuSign.

4) Expected attachments: corrected W-9 (if applicable), signatory document, EIN evidence (we already have your screenshot), and preferred remittance details. Once we have 1+2 in place we can create a conditional PO (payment hold until ACH verification completes).

I've added Mina (finance) and Marissa (procurement) to the thread so they can approve the conditional PO once documents are validated. Our procurement ticket is PROC-3491.

DocuSign (optional): https://docusign.com/rooms/abc123-orchid
Vendor portal: https://vendors.redwood.ai/upload/orchid (secure)

Let me know which route you prefer for signing and we'll send the template.

Best,
